name: What common renovations help increase a rental property's value and tenant appeal?

mainEntity.name: What common renovations help increase a rental property's value and tenant appeal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common renovations that significantly boost a rental property's value and appeal include modernizing kitchens and bathrooms with updated fixtures and energy-efficient appliances, installing durable and attractive flooring like LVP or tile, and applying a fresh coat of neutral paint. Upgrading lighting, improving curb appeal with landscaping, and ensuring the property has reliable heating and cooling systems also make a big difference. These improvements help your property stand out in areas like Henderson and Summerlin, justifying higher rent and attracting tenants who are more likely to stay long-term.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, new flooring, fresh paint, and improved curb appeal commonly increase rental property value and tenant appeal.
